body:
Addressed: typed Chamfer lead lengths reset during the next UI render.

Cause: the Lead tab copied `lead` into a temporary shape. The type selector wrote the shape back, but a numeric edit did not write it back. The next render restored the original number.

Fix: the page now writes the shape back when the user selects a shape or changes its numeric value. Opening or painting the tab stays inert, so legacy operations keep their compatibility marker.

New head: `d6cbff161da44106892f831b1fae8d2ac960786d`.

Pin: `typing_a_chamfer_lead_size_stays_in_the_draft`.

Result: the Chamfer lead UI module passed 3 tests, 0 failed. No golden files changed.

This push changes the head. It waits for a fresh review.

Verification on head `d6cbff161da44106892f831b1fae8d2ac960786d`:

- UI library: 1692 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The working tree is clean.
- No golden files changed.

Default update after manual testing:

A Linear lead runs parallel to the selected edge. On this part, that tangent direction starts the plunge inside the finished surface. The full-cone check correctly refuses it. A Perpendicular lead starts on the physical air side and works on this edge selection.

New 2D Chamfer operations now default to Perpendicular, 3 mm, with the same lead for lead-out. Legacy saved projects keep their old compatibility behavior. Users can still select None or another lead shape.

New head: `4188f677ffbc5280c6ddda785c81f292cca11dd1`.

Focused verification:
- App Chamfer lead tests: 3 passed.
- MCP Chamfer lead tests: 1 passed.
- UI Chamfer lead tests: 3 passed.
- Clippy for app and UI: passed.

This push changes the head and waits for a fresh review.

Manual UI test on head `4188f677ffbc5280c6ddda785c81f292cca11dd1`:

- New 2D Chamfer operations show a 3 mm Perpendicular lead-in by default.
- The lead-out uses the same shape and length.
- The generated path uses the physical air side on the selected edge.
- A typed lead length stays at the entered value.

The maintainer confirmed that the UI result looks good. This head still waits for a fresh review.

Reviewer: wopr pool job review-4173, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney (/home/mikekinney/.claude-mkinney); did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.**

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR changes generated toolpaths and posted G-code, and it adds collision checks for the Chamfer leads.

## What looks good

- The lead planner refuses a lead that does not fit. It does not post the bare wall ride. Mutation 1 below proves that the full-tool check is pinned.
- The v82 compatibility marker (an absent `lead` key) is pinned in the load path, the stamp and the seed. Mutation 2 below proves it.
- `Lead::is_sane`, `scaled`, `size` and `kind` move to `contour_params.rs`. Contour and Chamfer now share one validation.
- The stamp writes no new byte for a legacy operation (`mill2d.rs`, the `0xC2` marker).
- The new motion files stay under 400 lines. Each new module has a provenance line.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/3237-chamfer-lead-in-out.md` names the default and the dropped options.

## Results (locally, host wopr, trial merge with upstream/main `b2afd64ed`)

The trial merge has conflicts (finding 4). To build, I resolved them locally only: I kept the v84 text of main and stepped this PR to v85. I did not push this resolution.

- Build: `camcraft-motion`, `camcraft-app` (tests, `--no-run`): pass.
- Motion: `chamfer_circular` 17, `chamfer_minimum_radius` 9, `chamfer_open_refusals` 3, `climb_direction` 9, `deburr` 2, `lead_room` 19, `contour_tab_lead` 4 (1 ignored): all pass.
- App: `chamfer_minimum_radius` 6, `chamfer_open_edges` 6, `chamfer_partly_bevelled` 2, `mcp_chamfer_minimum_radius` 2, `mill2d_b` 9, `setup_align_chamfer` 86, `stock_source_holes` 2, `project_roundtrip` 9: all pass.
- App: **`chamfer_modelled_edge`: FAILED, 3 passed, 4 failed** (finding 1).
- App: **`example_catalog`: FAILED, 43 passed, 1 failed, 4 ignored** (finding 2). `example_catalog_adaptive` 1 and `example_catalog_edge_work` 1: pass.
- UI: `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`): 1773 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: pass.
- Light lane: not run. The verdict does not depend on it.

### Extra suites run

- Every `camcraft-app` suite that builds a `Chamfer2D` operation: `area_controls` 13, `coarse_laws` 6, `deburr_chord_width` 7, `edge_break_bound` 5, `edge_break_gate` 5, `edge_volume_bound` 2, `feature_edge_g1_join` 5, `mcp_pick` 8, `model_fidelity` 9, `probe_op` 12, `setup_carry_credits` 7, `tilted_gouge_kinds` 10, `tool_law` 7, `turning_contour_stock` 3: all pass.
- No file under `testdata/` changed. No importer code changed.

### The two red steps on bare main and on the bare PR head

| Step | Trial merge | PR head `4188f67` alone | Bare upstream/main `b2afd64` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chamfer_modelled_edge` | 4 failed | 4 failed | 7 passed |
| `example_catalog` | 1 failed | 1 failed | 44 passed |

This PR causes the two red steps. The PR body reports `example_catalog: 43 passed`. That run came before the last commit, which changed the seed to a 3 mm Perpendicular lead.

## Mutations (SAFETY tier)

1. `chamfer_lead_check.rs` `full_tool_holds`: return `Ok(())` at the top. **Red**: 3 tests in `chamfer_circular::leads` (`blocked_requested_lead_refuses_instead_of_posting_the_bare_wall`, `blocked_requested_leads_halve_separately_and_name_each_note`, `lead_refuses_a_modelled_body_collision_above_the_cone`). Restored.
2. `params_impl.rs` load: change an absent `lead` to `Some(Lead::None)`. **Red**: 4 tests in app `chamfer_minimum_radius`, including `leads::v82_absent_lead_fields_keep_the_old_open_path_marker`. Restored.

## Requested before merge

1. **`chamfer_modelled_edge` is red: 4 of 7 tests fail** (`crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs:911`, the new seed).
   - `a_no_pick_chamfer_on_a_rectangular_pocket_stays_clean` now refuses a legal no-pick chamfer:
     ```
     generate: Machining("OP: invalid machining parameters: 2D Chamfer perpendicular lead-in and perpendicular lead-out cannot fit after four halvings: full cone collision: move 0 cuts past the finish surface; shorten the requested lead or move the selected edge into air")
     ```
     Move 0 is the plunge at the lead entry. A halving cannot correct a plunge that is in material. Thus the entry point is possibly on the material side of the pocket rim. Find the cause. Do not only change the assertion.
   - `a_no_pick_chamfer_on_a_modelled_chamfer_rides_the_wall`, `the_width_moves_the_tip_along_the_bevel_not_only_in_z` and `a_no_pick_chamfer_leaves_a_sharp_pocket_beside_a_modelled_chamfer_alone` fail because the lead feed moves are not on the wall (for example `Point3 { x: 20.0, y: 13.0, z: 9.0 }`). These tests must state what a lead move may do. Their `verification_gate` assertions must still run.
   - The class of the problem: the seed changes each new Chamfer operation. Give one rule for it. For example: a seeded default must not refuse a part that the no-lead path cuts, and every suite that builds a `Chamfer2D` must run on the final head.

2. **`example_catalog` is red: `catalog_2d_edge_work::rebuilds`** (`examples/catalog/2d/edge-work/edge-work.nc`). The build now posts a lead-in from `X33. Y20.` and a lead-out to `X30. Y23.`. The committed `.nc` does not have these moves. The PR body says "No PR-owned golden changed". Do one of these:
   - Move the recorded program. List it under "Goldens moved" in the body, with the reason.
   - Keep the catalog output unchanged.

3. **The explicit-lead open path does not do the air-side material check** (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/chamfer_open.rs:91-95`). The check "the tip offset reaches selected-model material on the air side" is now only in `legacy_open_ride`. A probe test proves this. I used the fixture of `an_open_chain_offsets_on_its_named_air_side_and_keeps_its_break` (minimum radius 2, material at `rect(-10, 21, 10, 25)`) with `lead: Some(Lead::None)`. `chamfer_open_runs` accepted it and the ride goes through that material at Y 22. With a real lead, `full_tool_holds` exempts the first cut move. For a two-point run, that is the whole ride. The final verification gate possibly finds the gouge, but this review did not prove it. New operations take this path by default. Do the swept-region check on the offset pass for the two paths, before the leads are added. Pin it with an explicit lead.

4. **The PR conflicts with main: the project-format ladder** (`crates/app/src/project/file.rs`, `crates/app/src/project/apply.rs`, `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.camproj`). Main is now at v84 (#4031 `cutter_hand`, #3645 tool components). Both sides changed the same ladder, so the author must do this merge:
   - Step this PR to v85.
   - Keep the v83 and v84 text of main.
   - Change `assert_eq!(project::PROJECT_VERSION, 83)` and the v82 fixture in `crates/app/tests/chamfer_minimum_radius/leads.rs:114-124`.
   - Change the `pre-v83` and `v82` words in the comments and doc text.

5. **No before and after screenshots.** The PR adds a Leads tab with two editors to the 2D Chamfer page (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_more_page.rs:217-236`). The body must link before and after screenshots. Put the images on the images-only `pr-screenshots` branch of your fork, not in the tree.

## Optional, non-blocking

- `crates/app/src/operation/types/params.rs:435`: the doc comment says "New operations state `Some(Lead::None)`". The seed is now `Some(Lead::Perpendicular { length: 3.0 })`. Change the comment.
- After the fixes, run the quick gate again on the final head. Then put the new counts in the body. The current counts (821 of 822, catalog 43) are from an earlier head.
- `sane.rs` (1514 lines) and `params_impl.rs` (3076 lines) were already over 400 lines. This PR adds a little to each.

## Notes

- Clean-room: no finding. Layers: no finding. The motion code does not import `app`.
- The title has `!` and the body states the project-format break. The body has `Changelog:` and ends with `Fixes #3237`.
- This is a `feat`. It merges at the next minor cut.
- No collaborator review asked for changes on this head before this one.
